title: Begeleider autiwerking - onbepaalde duur
description:
Onze kinderen en jongeren zijn stuk voor stuk uniek. Ze spelen, ontdekken, leren, lachen, zoeken grenzen op en groeien elke dag een beetje verder. Soms loopt dat vlot, soms is daar extra ondersteuning voor nodig.

Daarom zoeken we begeleiders die naast hen willen staan: mensen die rust en structuur bieden, vertrouwen geven en samen met hen op weg gaan. Niet om hen te veranderen, maar om hen te helpen groeien op een manier die bij hen past.

  • In zorggroep De Mast begeleid je een groep kinderen van 6 tot 13 jaar met een autismespectrumstoornis en bijkomende gedrags- en emotionele problemen en/of een licht verstandelijke beperking.

  • Je biedt hen dagelijkse ondersteuning binnen een specifiek leefklimaat. Hierbij focus je op de sterktes en de groeikansen van de kinderen/jongeren en hun gezinnen.

  • Je biedt een veilige en aangename plek waar ze kunnen opgroeien en ontwikkelen op hun eigen manier. Hierbij laat je ruimte voor inspraak en directe betrokkenheid.

  • Je ondersteunt jongeren in het versterken van hun zelfredzaamheid, het ontwikkelen van sociale vaardigheden en het invullen van een zinvolle dag- en vrijetijdsbesteding.

  • Je begeleidt jongeren in het leren omgaan met emoties, spanningen en gedrag en helpt hen stap voor stap groeien.

  • Je bezit een (ortho)pedagogisch diploma of evenwaardig (al dan niet door ervaring).

  • Je bent –naast een groepswerker- ook geïnteresseerd in het individueel werken met jongeren met een complexe problematiek.

  • Je bewaart de nodige rust in stresssituaties en ontmijnt conflicten op een respectvolle manier.

  • Je hebt een stevige ruggengraat, bent positief ingesteld en haalt voldoening uit kleine stapjes die kinderen en jongeren zetten.

  • Je hebt een groot talent voor probleemoplossend werken en denkt graag out of the box.

  • Je bezit, naast je begeleiderstalent, ook administratieve en praktische vaardigheden.

  • Je hebt zin in een wisselend uurrooster (vroegdiensten, late diensten, weekends, slapende nachten).

  • Je bezit een rijbewijs B.

title: HOTELRECEPTIONIST / HOTELRECEPTIONISTE (Front Office)
description:
Flanders Hotel Brugge is een charmant, familiaal viersterrenhotel in het historische hart van Brugge. Gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en persoonlijke service staan bij ons centraal. Om ons enthousiaste Guest Services-team te versterken, zoeken wij een ervaren en talenknappe hotelreceptionist(e) met een passie voor hospitality.

Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, hou je van contact met internationale gasten en werk je graag in een professionele maar warme omgeving? Dan ben jij misschien de collega die wij zoeken.

Jouw functie

Als hotelreceptionist(e) ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten en draag je dagelijks bij aan een onvergetelijke verblijfservaring.

Je takenpakket omvat onder meer:

  • Het professioneel ontvangen, inchecken en uitchecken van gasten.
  • Het behandelen van reservaties, administratieve taken en correspondentie.
  • Het verstrekken van toeristische informatie over Brugge en de hotelvoorzieningen.
  • Het beantwoorden van vragen en het oplossen van klachten op een gastgerichte manier.
  • Het actief inspelen op commerciële opportuniteiten en het bieden van een uitstekende service.
  • Het samenwerken met verschillende afdelingen binnen het hotel.
  • Het zelfstandig beheren van de receptie tijdens bepaalde shifts.

Elke dag is anders: je komt in contact met gasten uit de hele wereld en maakt deel uit van een dynamische en boeiende werkomgeving.

Jouw profiel

Wij zoeken een collega die ervaring combineert met enthousiasme en een echte passie voor gastvrijheid.

Je beschikt over:

  • Ervaring als hotelreceptionist(e) of een gelijkwaardige functie binnen de hospitalitysector.
  • Een zeer goede kennis van Nederlands, Frans en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Een basiskennis van Duits; kennis van Spaans of andere talen is een extra troef.
  • Goede computervaardigheden en affiniteit met moderne hotelsoftware.
  • Een commerciële ingesteldheid en een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
  • Een verzorgde en professionele uitstraling.

Daarnaast ben je:

  • Gastvrij, spontaan en behulpzaam.
  • Zelfstandig, maar ook een echte teamspeler.
  • Flexibel op het vlak van shifts en weekendwerk.
  • Stressbestendig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Iemand die initiatief neemt, logisch nadenkt en werk ziet.
  • Bereid om indien nodig sporadisch in te springen als nachtreceptionist(e).
  • Op zoek naar een langdurige samenwerking.

title: Flexi-job - medewerker SingCity - Kinepolis Gent
description:
Over SingCity

Ben jij klaar om de show te stelen? Met tomeloos enthousiasme introduceren we SingCity: een plek waar het elke dag feest is!

Bij SingCity bieden we onze gasten een onvergetelijke karaoke-ervaring, aangevuld met drankjes, hapjes en unieke evenementen. Met jou erbij willen we ons team versterken en onze klanten elke dag opnieuw een fantastische tijd bezorgen.

SingCity is een gloednieuw concept van Kinepolis Group, en deze vestiging is de allereerste in zijn soort.

Wat ga je doen?

Als flexi-jobber werk je actief mee om onze gasten een geweldige ervaring te bieden, zowel aan het onthaal als aan de bar!

  • Host: je neemt de rol van host op en zorgt voor een warme en enthousiaste ontvangst van onze gasten.
  • Je neemt bestellingen op, maakt de diverse snacks en drankje klaar en brengt ze tot bij de klant. Tijdens dit proces waak je erover dat de klanten niet te lang moeten wachten op hun bestellingen.
  • Je volgt nauwgezet onze kwaliteitsstandaarden en hygiënevoorschriften op om te voldoen aan de hoogste normen voor hygiëne en voedselveiligheid.
  • Je biedt ondersteuning bij stockbeheer
  • Ad-hoc schakelen: Je springt bij waar nodig, of het nu gaat om problemen met apparatuur, het waarborgen van de hygiënestandaarden,… Niets is jou te veel!

Wat maakt dit een leuke job?

  • Je werkt in een levendige en energieke omgeving waar geen enkele dag hetzelfde is.
  • Je krijgt de kans om mee te denken en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van dit nieuwe concept. Jouw ideeën en input kunnen direct invloed hebben op het succes van de locatie.

Wie ben jij?

  • Ervaring in de horeca of een gelijkaardige sector is een plus om dit nieuwe concept te helpen uitbouwen.
  • Klantgerichtheid zodat onze gasten zorgeloos kunnen genieten van hun uitstap.
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden zodat ons team volledig op elkaar ingespeeld is.
  • Je bent plichtsbewust en geeft de nodige aandacht aan orde, structuur, netheid en hygiëne.
  • Je straalt enthousiasme en gastvrijheid uit.
  • Flexibiliteit: avond- en weekenddiensten zijn standaard en passen jou perfect. Boodschappen doen buiten de piekmomenten? Ideaal!

Plaats van tewerkstelling: Kinepolis Gent

Geïnteresseerd?

Interesse om het team van Kinepolis sterren te versterken? Solliciteer dan snel online.

title: CNC operator
description:
Position:


As an important link in providing our customers with excellent service and reliability, you will be responsible for transforming raw materials into a high-quality finished product by:

  • Operating, monitoring and adjusting CNC machines.
  • Closely following the production schedule to ensure that finished products are completed on time.
  • Accurately measuring the milled components.
  • Maintaining a safe and tidy working environment.

Profile:

  • You have an affinity with woodworking.
  • You are motivated, enjoy working as part of a team and have no physical limitations that would prevent you from performing the job.
  • You have basic knowledge of CNC machine operation, WoodWOP and Maestro (internal training will be provided).
  • You have good technical insight and are able to read and interpret technical drawings.
  • You are comfortable working either in a day shift or a two-shift system.
  • A forklift certificate is an advantage.
  • You can demonstrate a stable employment history and/or provide positive references.

title: Production Operator
description:
Your responsibilities:

  • Operating and monitoring linen processing equipment
  • Sorting, handling, folding, and preparing linen products
  • Checking products for quality and reporting any defects
  • Following safety, hygiene, and production procedures
  • Keeping your work area clean and organized
  • Working efficiently to meet daily production targets
  • Cooperating with colleagues and supervisors

Requirements:

  • No previous experience is required; full training will be provided
  • Reliable, responsible, and motivated attitude
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Good physical condition and willingness to perform repetitive tasks
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team
  • You are not afraid working in dust

title: Vak- & studiecoach op zaterdag {deeltijds _ studentenjob}
description:
Re-Mind is een coachbureau met 10 vaste medewerkers en een 50-tal freelance coaches.

Onze missie?
Iedereen begeleiden en ondersteunen in zijn of haar groeiproces. Dit van studiecoaching, tot examencommissie, tot businesscoaching, tot educatie.

Ben jij benieuwd?

Neem dan een kijkje op onze site: https://www.re-mind.be/.

Zie je jezelf in een coachende rol om leerlingen uit het lager & middelbaar onderwijs te ondersteunen doorheen vakspecifieke bijles en|of studiebegeleiding?

Dan ben jij de persoon die we zoeken.
Amaze yourself en solliciteer bij Re-Mind!

Takenpakket

Je geeft coaching vanuit jouw vakgebied (Frans, wetenschappen, wiskunde, economische vakken, ...) aan onze leerlingen middelbaar onderwijs, studenten hoger onderwijs en|of aan onze studenten examencommissie (2e & vooral 3e graad).

Dit doe je zeker niet alleen!
Een team van collega's en coaches staat altijd paraat om er samen voor te gaan.

We luisteren graag naar jou en ondersteunen jou dan ook waar mogelijk.
Er wordt van jou thuis geen extra voorbereiding verwacht.

Gewenste competenties

Jij zet sterk in op je communicatie over jouw wensen, werkpunten, noden,.... Enkel door te communiceren geraken we samen tot een oplossing.

Jij hebt people skills. Je kan goed om met leerlingen|studenten, je krijgt hen dan ook mee in je verhaal. Ook klantvriendelijke communicatie vind je belangrijk.

Je bent iemand die zich wil inzetten voor het team, onze leerlingen|studenten en ons bedrijf.

Jouw algemene kennis is zeer breed. Je kan over de meeste vakken tot en met het 3e middelbaar wel iets vertellen. Voor de vakken vanuit jouw vakgebied kan je lesgeven tot en met het hoger onderwijs.

Individueel werken vind je geen probleem, de coaching is steeds 1 op 1. Daarnaast vind jij ook een sterk|tof team belangrijk.

Je kan je passie voor je vak overbrengen op een heel toegankelijke manier.

Professionele vaardigheden

  • Het pedagogisch project mee uitwerken
  • Algemene vakken aanleren
  • Lesgeven in het secundair onderwijs
  • De studiemethodiek van leerlingen ondersteunen
  • Leerresultaten evalueren
  • Een educatief evenement organiseren
  • Leerlingen of studenten adviseren bij oriëntering
  • Bijles geven
  • Het leerproces differentiëren
  • Leermiddelen uitwerken
  • Leerlingen met een leerstoornis begeleiden
  • Leerdoelen bepalen
  • Werkadministratie bijhouden

Persoonlijke vaardigheden

  • Betrouwbaarheid
  • Communiceren
  • Coachen
  • Klantgerichtheid
  • Analyseren
  • Verantwoordelijkheid
  • Stressbestendigheid
  • Kritisch denken

title: Teamleader Klus
employer: SOCIAAL ONDERNEMEN BRUGGE EN OMGEVING AAN HET WERK VZW
description:
Als teamleader ben jij de drijvende kracht achter een enthousiast team van medewerkers binnen onze klus- en groendienst. Je werk is gevarieerd, praktisch én mensgericht:

· Je leidt en coacht je team op de werkvloer.

· Je geeft heldere werkinstructies en zorgt voor een efficiënte taakverdeling.

· Je werkt actief mee aan diverse opdrachten: zwerfvuil ruimen, onderhoud van openbaar groen, tuinklussen bij particulieren, waterhydranten onderhouden, opruimen en klussen in het havengebied, verhuizen, opkuis van vervuilde woningen en andere onderhoudsopdrachten.

· Je bewaakt de veiligheid, kwaliteit en klantentevredenheid bij elke opdracht.

· Je stimuleert medewerkers om (nieuwe) vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en hun zelfvertrouwen te versterken. Je haalt het beste in hen naar boven.

Kortom: als teamleader ben je zowel een meewerkende als een inspirerende coach.

- Je hebt ervaring in leiding geven

- Je hebt vakkennis van klussen en groenonderhoud

- Samenwerken is helemaal jouw ding

- Je bent sociaal, positief ingesteld en weet hoe je mensen motiveert

- Je kan vlot communiceren en durft bijsturen waar nodig

- Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit, weet van aanpakken en werkt graag actief mee

- Je hecht veel belang aan veilig werken, kwaliteit afleveren en tevreden klanten

- Je hebt een rijbewijs B

title: Test Automation Engineer – TypeScript & AI
description:
Responsibilities

  • Analyze functional documentation and business requirements to define expected system behavior and test scenarios.
  • Review and validate test cases and scripts produced by AI agents against acceptance criteria and business stories.
  • Perform manual testing to verify the scope, accuracy, and completeness of automated test scripts.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives within a Scrum framework.
  • Collaborate with development and AI research teams to provide feedback on the quality and coverage of AI-generated scripts.
  • Compare manual test coverage results with AI-driven execution to ensure consistency and reliability.

Requirements

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a test specialist working on large-scale, business-critical applications.
  • You possess 5+ years of experience in test automation using TypeScript for script development.
  • You bring 3+ years of experience in test automation and formal testing methodologies such as ISTQB.
  • You have 3+ years of experience testing business applications, transaction systems, and related integrations.
  • You possess 3+ years of experience working in Scrum environments and Agile workflows.
  • You bring 3+ years of experience with Jira for sprint management and Zephyr for test cycle orchestration.
  • You have proven experience with BDD test scripts and functional testing techniques.
  • You're able to clearly report and document test results and findings.
  • You are proactive and solution-oriented.
  • You are fluent in Dutch with a level of C2.

Nice to Haves

  • 3+ years of experience with Playwright for test case scripting.
  • Knowledge of Leapwork and TDD methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Shift Left principles in an Agile context.
  • Willingness to gain a deep understanding of complex business processes.

title: Helpdesk Technician
description:
We are seeking an energetic and detail-oriented Helpdesk Technician for our 6-month-project in the pharmaceutical industry, based onsite at our Zaventem office. As part of our team, you will play a critical role in preparing and installing IT equipment for clinical studies, working closely with global operational teams, vendors, and clients.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Oversee client project provisioning and logistics;
  • Assess mobile computing needs for clinical systems;
  • Provide procurement support and manage vendor relationships;
  • Evaluate shipping options and handle documentation;
  • Communicate project status and manage resources;
  • Create and update project work plans;
  • Ensure compliance with SOPs and project standards;
  • Identify and resolve provisioning issues;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Assist in project design, testing, and documentation;
  • Mentor staff and support business development efforts;
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.
  • Knowledge of emerging technologies, service delivery, and mobile computing;
  • Experience in logistics and telecommunications;
  • Strong time management and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to handle challenging situations with patience and respect;
  • Experience with global project rollouts;
  • Strong technical proficiency and vendor management experience;
  • Preferred knowledge of software development and testing;
  • Familiarity with cross-functional project management and IT applications;
  • Skilled in technical planning and building consensus;
  • Effective communication with senior management and direct reports;
  • Excellent English written and verbal communication skills;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a collaborative environment.

title: Technical Support Advisor
description:
As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area.

Your missions:

Customer & internal technical support

  • Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors.
  • Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions
  • Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors.
  • Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team.
  • Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team.
  • Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.

Continuous improvement & documentation

  • Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement.
  • Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product).
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
  • Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams.
  • Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.

Team

You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.

Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function
  • Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions
  • Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides
  • Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)

Your soft skills and personal qualities:

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers
  • Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation
  • Method, rigor and stress management
  • Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback
  • Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

  • Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
  • Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
  • Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.

title: Reach truck operator
description:
TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is Toyota's European distribution center. It supplies Toyota and Lexus parts to distributors throughout Europe. In addition, TPCE delivers directly to garages and dealerships in Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, and Northern France. At the Diest facility, imported Toyota and Lexus automotive parts are stored, orders for dealers and distributors are picked and assembled, and shipments are prepared and dispatched. TPCE is a modern, highly automated distribution center specializing in automotive parts logistics.


Jobomschrijving

Toyota Diest is looking for reach truck operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Reach Truck Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a reach truck.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

title: Country Manager - eMobility - BeLux
description:
Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.


Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

  • Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
  • Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
  • Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.



Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

  • Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
  • Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
  • Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.



Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

  • Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
  • Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
  • Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.



Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

  • Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
  • Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
  • Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).



Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

  • Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
  • Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.



Prepare the ground for future local expansion

  • Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
  • Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

  • Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
  • Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
  • Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
  • Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English.

title: CE Distribution Driver
description:
Wat ga je doen?

As a CE driver, you carry out regional distribution runs and deliver goods safely, accurately and with a strong focus on customer service to a wide range of customers.

You will join a growing transport company specialised in national distribution. Safety, reliability and customer focus are key. You can count on clear agreements, personal guidance and a working environment where drivers are valued.

You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck. You carry out distribution runs for various customers and are given the necessary independence and responsibility. The planning team provides clear structure, and you have fixed points of contact you can turn to with any questions.

- You carry out regional or national distribution runs for a variety of customers.
- You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck.
- You transport goods safely and professionally.
- You follow the schedule and ensure punctual deliveries.
- You communicate with customers in a friendly and professional manner.
- You take responsibility for your routes and equipment.
- You can count on support from the planning team and HR.
- You receive internal training and guidance from experienced colleagues and coaches.

You work from Monday to Friday. You start each day between 4:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m., depending on your route schedule.

Wie ben jij?
  • You are customer-oriented and punctual.
  • You take responsibility while on the road.
  • You have a flexible and professional attitude.
  • You preferably live within a 20-kilometre radius of Desteldonk.
  • You enjoy working independently and value clear agreements.

Opleiding: No specific diploma required.

Vakkennis: Experience as a driver or in distribution transport is an advantage, but not required.

Talenkennis: You speak Dutch, French or English.

Attesten: Valid CE driving licence, valid medical fitness certificate, Code 95 Certificate of Professional Competence and digital tachograph driver card.

Wat bieden wij jou?
  • You receive personal guidance, clear agreements and opportunities to further develop yourself.
  • You receive an attractive salary based on your experience.
  • A meal allowance of €9 per day worked.
  • A dedicated truck that you use to depart from Desteldonk every day.
  • A company car after six months, which you may also use for private purposes.
.

title: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

title: Shiftmanager Fastfood/Horeca
description:
Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap als leidinggevende? Zoek je een job met veel doorgroeimogelijkheden, een hecht team en de zekerheid van een stabiele werkgever? Dan hebben wij dé kans voor jou!

In deze functie stuur je het team aan tijdens jouw shift. Je zorgt dat alles soepel loopt: van een vlotte service tot tevreden klanten. Samen met je collega’s bouw je mee aan een positieve werksfeer én aan jouw toekomst. Je krijgt volop kansen om door te groeien richting hogere managementrollen.

Waarom is dit dé job voor jou?

  • Je zet je leidinggevende skills in én bouwt ze verder uit.
  • Je werkt in een team waar samenwerking centraal staat.
  • Je krijgt begeleiding en kansen om door te groeien.
  • Als shiftmanager start je in de functie van 'gewone' medewerker voor ongeveer een maand, om de flow te leren kennen, daarna start je aan jouw opleidingstraject als shiftmanager. Ongeveer een half jaar een examen in NL later ben je klaar om jouw rol op te nemen.

Als shiftmanager stuur jij samen met een collega shiftmanager een team van 25 mensen aan. Jullie krijgen de planning een maand op voorhand door.

Doorheen de dag lossen jullie problemen op in het team of met klanten. Belangrijk dus om communicatief sterk in jouw schoenen te staan.

Je werkt in vaste uurblokken die zich situeren tussen 8u 's morgens en 01.00u 's avonds.

  • Je bent communicatief zeer sterk en weet hoe je een team moet aansturen. People management ligt jou.
  • Je bent flexibel in werktijden, zowel in avondwerk als weekendwerk.
  • Je bent klaar om te groeien, zowel als persoon als in functie.

title: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

  • Transport of frozen goods
  • National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
  • Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
  • Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

  • Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
  • Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
  • Has a good level of English
  • Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
  • Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

title: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

  • Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
  • Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

  • Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
  • Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
  • Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

title: Forklift Operator
description:
Toyota Diest is looking for forklift operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Forklift Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a forklift.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

title: Business Analyst  & Transformation Project lead
description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

  • Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
  • Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
  • Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Business Process Improvement

  • Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
  • Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.

  • Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
  • Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.  

We’re an energetic, innovative and forward thinking team who are always looking for new ideas to delight and wow our customers.  The Customer Advisor is required to:

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We focus on customer engagement and improving business outcomes for over 450 global clients across many continents. Our 100,000+ staff deliver technology-infused, omni-channel customer experience management, marketing optimization, digital, consulting, analytics and back office solutions in 40+ languages from 125+ delivery centres. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: 6. NADZORNIK/CA
description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 6. Naziv radnog mjesta: NADZORNIK (m/ž) – 1 izvršitelj/izvršiteljica Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, edukacija kroz seminar Slučajni spasilac (edukacija se može provesti u roku od 2 mjeseca od zaposlenja) Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,44 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brine za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada i sl. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, 84/21), kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz citiranih odredbi Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama/835 . Kandidat koji se, sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj biti će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave javnog natječaja u novinama, na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a te na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima. Prijave s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – PRIJAM U RADNI ODNOS – NAZIV I REDNI BROJ RADNOG MJESTA ZA KOJE SE PODNOSI PRIJAVA“ dostavljaju se na adresu: Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Baštijanova 52a, 10 000 Zagreb. Ustanova Upravljanje sportskim objektima zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu, odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera“. Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugu javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). https://mrosp.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama-16/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-12153/rad-i-zaposljavanje/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-i-zaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom/5946 Vodoopskrba i odvodnja d.o.o. zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu te ne prihvatiti ni jednu dostavljenu ponudu.

Stručni uvjeti: KV/SSS tehničkog smjera, vozački ispit, poznavanje rada na računalu.
Na oglas se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad.
  
U prijavi na oglas potrebno je navesti osobne podatke podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te po mogućnosti e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje.
Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.
Uz prijavu, kandidati  su dužni priložiti:
•životopis
•dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslika / scan osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice)
•presliku / scan svjedodžbe,
•vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
  
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici ili scanu, a prije izbora kandidat/kinja će predočiti izvornik.
Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se do 30. rujna 2026. godine na adresu VODNE USLUGE d.o.o., Bjelovar, Ferde Rusana 21, s naznakom - „prijava na oglas“ ili e-mailom na adresu: pisarnica@vodneusluge-bj.hr
Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u oglasu.
Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovremenu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz oglasa, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na oglas.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan/na je u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), dužan/a se u prijavi na oglas pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.  Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu je dužan osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.
Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz oglasa bit će proveden usmeni razgovor, a o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem kontakt broja telefona odnosno mobitela ili e-mail adrese iz prijave.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a nije pristupio/ila usmenom razgovoru više se ne smatra kandidatom/kinjom u postupku.
O rezultatima oglasa kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem.    
  
VODNE USLUGE d.o.o. pridržavaju pravo poništiti ovaj natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku, bez posebnog obrazloženja.

title: DIPLOMIRANI INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA-INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA -PROJEKTANT
description:
PROJEKTANT HIDROTEHNIČKE STRUKE (m/ž) Želite raditi na projektima koji imaju stvaran utjecaj na razvoj gradova i infrastrukture? PRONING DHI d.o.o. traži diplomiranog inženjera građevinarstva / inženjera građevinarstva – projektanta (m/ž) koji želi svoje znanje razvijati kroz rad na složenim hidrotehničkim projektima u Hrvatskoj i regiji. Ako vas zanimaju hidrotehnika, projektiranje, modeliranje i suvremene tehnologije, a želite raditi u stručnom timu i sudjelovati u projektima od koncepcije do realizacije, voljeli bismo vas upoznati. TKO SMO MI? PRONING DHI je privatno projektno društvo iz Zagreba, osnovano 1994. godine. Više od 30 godina bavimo se projektiranjem i konzaltingom u području:
  • urbane hidrotehnike
  • hidrotehnike riječnih slivova
  • eko-inženjerstva.
Sudjelovali smo u izradi kompleksnih hidrotehničkih projekata u Hrvatskoj i regiji – od master planova kanalizacijskih sustava Zagreba, Ljubljane i Osijeka do projekta odvodnje EKO-Kaštelanskog zaljeva. Posebnu pažnju posvećujemo primjeni suvremenih tehnologija. U radu koristimo i razvijamo 1D i 2D matematičke simulacijske modele, a bavimo se i razvojem sustava za predviđanje poplava u realnom vremenu. ŠTO ĆETE RADITI? Kao član našeg projektnog tima sudjelovat ćete u:
  • izradi i vođenju tehničke dokumentacije u području komunalne hidrotehnike
  • razvoju koncepcijskih rješenja te izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata
  • izradi studija izvodljivosti
  • ishođenju akata za građenje
  • koordinaciji i suradnji s različitim stručnjacima i sudionicima u procesu projektiranja
  • drugim stručnim poslovima iz područja hidrotehničkog projektiranja, ovisno o vašem iskustvu i stručnosti.
Drugim riječima, ne tražimo samo izvršitelja zadataka, već stručnjaka koji želi sudjelovati u razvoju kvalitetnih projektnih rješenja. KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo osobu koja ima:
  • VSS – dipl. ing. građ. / mag. ing. aedif. ili VŠS – ing. građ.
  • iskustvo u izradi hidrotehničkih projekata
  • dobro poznavanje tehničke i zakonske regulative iz područja građevinarstva
  • napredno znanje rada u MS Officeu, AutoCAD-u i Urbanu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • znanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika.
Prednost, ali ne i uvjet, predstavljaju:
  • najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva
  • poznavanje SWMM-a i EPANET-a
  • poznavanje GIS alata poput ArcGIS-a i QGIS-a
  • ovlaštenje za inženjera i upis u imenik ovlaštenih inženjera strukovne komore s položenim stručnim ispitom.
Nemate sve navedene kvalifikacije? Ako ste građevinski tehničar s relevantnim radnim iskustvom, također ste dobrodošli prijaviti se. ZAŠTO PRONING DHI? Kod nas ćete imati priliku: RADITI NA SLOŽENIM PROJEKTIMA Sudjelovat ćete na domaćim i internacionalnim projektima u području hidrotehnike. KORISTITI SUVREMENE TEHNOLOGIJE Radit ćete s modernim alatima i tehnologijama, uključujući matematičko modeliranje hidrotehničkih sustava. RAZVIJATI SVOJE ZNANJE Omogućujemo stručno usavršavanje i razvoj kroz rad na različitim projektima. BITI DIO STRUČNOG TIMA Radit ćete u poticajnom i dinamičnom okruženju, uz suradnju s različitim stručnjacima. IMATI STABILNE UVJETE RADA Rad se uglavnom odvija u našem uredu u Zagrebu, uz povremene terenske obilaske i neradne vikende. Uz osnovna primanja nudimo i dodatke na plaću u skladu s ostvarenim rezultatima, božićnicu, uskrsnicu i potporu za godišnji odmor. MJESTO RADA Zagreb – ured PRONING DHI Povremeni terenski obilasci prema potrebama projekata. Vrsta zaposlenja: rad na određeno vrijeme, uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja nakon isteka probnog perioda. ZAINTRIGIRALO VAS JE? Ako želite svoje znanje iz građevinarstva i hidrotehnike usmjeriti prema složenim projektima, suvremenim tehnologijama i stručnom razvoju, pošaljite nam svoj životopis. Prijava treba sadržavati:
  • CV / životopis s kontakt podacima
  • motivacijsko pismo.
Prijave se šalju na: info@proning-dhi.hr PRONING DHI d.o.o. Otona Kučere 5, 10000 Zagreb www.proning-dhi.hr

title: PROJEKTANT/PROJEKTANTICA
description:

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih i građevinskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske i građevinske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih radova.

title: PROJEKTANT SURADNIK/PROJEKTANTICA SURADNICA
description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

title: SERVISER/SERVISERKA HIDRAULIČNIH NADOGRADNJI I RADNIH STROJEVA
description:
SERVISER/KA HIDRAULIČNIH NADOGRADNJI I RADNIH STROJEVA Mjesto rada: Osijek Radno vrijeme: ponedjeljak – petak, 7:00 – 15:00 sati Rok za prijavu: 30.09.2026. Opis poslova:
  • servisiranje i popravak hidrauličnih nadogradnji i radnih strojeva
  • dijagnostika i otklanjanje mehaničkih i hidrauličnih kvarova
  • remont hidrauličnih i mehaničkih sklopova
  • rastavljanje, pregled, popravak i ponovno sastavljanje sklopova
  • popravak i remont hidrauličnih cilindara
  • zamjena i ugradnja hidrauličnih pumpi, ventila, cilindara, crijeva i ostalih komponenti
  • zamjena ležajeva, brtvi i drugih istrošenih ili oštećenih dijelova
  • montaža i demontaža hidrauličnih nadogradnji, sklopova i opreme
  • preventivno i korektivno održavanje
  • ispitivanje i provjera funkcionalnosti stroja ili sustava nakon izvršenog popravka
  • ostali poslovi iz područja mehanike i hidraulike
  • Posao ponekad zahtjeva terenski rad.
Poslodavac traži:
  • dobro poznavanje mehanike i hidraulike
  • poželjno tehničko obrazovanje strojarskog, mehaničarskog ili srodnog usmjerenja
  • poželjno poznavanje osnova elektrike, posebno u svrhu dijagnostike kvarova na strojevima i nadogradnjama
  • iskustvo u radu s ručnim, električnim i mehaničarskim alatom
  • sposobnost samostalnog pronalaženja uzroka kvara i izvođenja popravka
  • odgovoran i uredan odnos prema poslu, alatu i opremi

  • osobu koja zna raditi rukama, razumije kako stroj i hidraulični sustav funkcioniraju te želi pronaći i riješiti kvar, a ne samo mijenjati dijelove prema uputama.
Prednost je iskustvo na servisiranju ili remontu hidrauličnih nadogradnji, radnih strojeva, građevinske ili komunalne mehanizacije, teretnih vozila ili drugih hidrauličnih sustava. Poslodavac nudi:
  • radno vrijeme od ponedjeljka do petka, 7:00 – 15:00 sati
  • slobodne vikende
  • kolektivni ljetni i zimski godišnji odmor
  • redovita primanja
  • stabilno zaposlenje
  • raznovrstan posao – od servisa i dijagnostike do složenijih popravaka i remonta
  • rad u radionici opremljenoj za servisiranje i remont
  • mogućnost dodatnog stručnog usavršavanja
  • radno mjesto u Osijeku
