title: Global Head Digital & Technology Officer, P&C
description:
About the Role

The Global Head Digital & Technology Officer, P&C Re is accountable for the end-to-end Digital & Technology agenda supporting our global Property & Casualty Reinsurance business.
As a member of the senior Digital & Technology leadership team and a strategic partner to the P&C Re Executive Leadership Team, this role shapes how technology enables the business to grow, operate efficiently, manage risk and respond to an evolving reinsurance landscape.
The role combines technology strategy, business transformation and large-scale operational leadership. It requires an executive who can translate business strategy into a clear technology agenda, lead a significant global technology organization and portfolio, and determine where modernization and innovation will deliver meaningful commercial value.
The successful candidate will bring deep experience operating at scale within complex, highly regulated financial services environments, together with the leadership capability to drive transformation across businesses, functions and geographies.

Key Responsibilities
Set the Digital & Technology Strategy
•    Own the global Digital & Technology strategy for P&C Re, ensuring technology priorities, investment and capabilities are closely aligned with business strategy and the broader Group technology agenda.
•    Act as a trusted strategic partner to P&C Re leadership, bringing a technology perspective to business strategy, growth, operational effectiveness and transformation.
•    Translate business priorities into a pragmatic, multi-year technology roadmap with clear outcomes, investment priorities and accountability.
•    Represent P&C Re within enterprise technology decision-making, ensuring opportunities for shared platforms, capabilities and investments are fully leveraged.
•    Maintain a forward-looking perspective on technology and industry developments, identifying where emerging capabilities can create meaningful competitive or operational advantage.
Lead Transformation, Engineering & Innovation
•    Lead the modernization and simplification of the P&C Re technology landscape, balancing transformation ambition with commercial value, operational stability and business continuity.
•    Strengthen modern engineering, architecture and delivery practices to improve speed, resilience, quality and predictability.
•    Drive transformation of technology operating models, including organizational structures, location strategy, sourcing and strategic technology partnerships.
•    Champion the responsible adoption of data, analytics, automation and AI, including Generative AI, to enhance productivity, decision-making and business outcomes.
•    Build an environment where innovation is encouraged while investment remains focused on opportunities with clear strategic or commercial value.
•    Partner across Digital & Technology to leverage enterprise capabilities while ensuring solutions meet the specific needs of the P&C Re business.
Own Technology Performance, Investment & Risk
•    Hold end-to-end accountability for a significant global technology organization, application landscape and investment portfolio supporting the P&C Re business.
•    Ensure technology services and platforms are resilient, secure, scalable and capable of supporting the evolving needs of the business.
•    Optimize technology investment, capacity and resources across strategic transformation and business-as-usual priorities.
•    Drive disciplined portfolio management and governance, providing transparency around investment, delivery, performance, risk and value realization.
•    Identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, consolidate capabilities and improve cost efficiency without compromising business delivery.
•    Ensure technology risk, cyber security, operational resilience and regulatory requirements are embedded within technology strategy and execution.
•    Engage confidently with Risk, Compliance, Audit and regulatory stakeholders, maintaining a strong culture of accountability and control.
Build a High-Performing Global Organization
•    Lead and develop a large, globally distributed technology organization, creating clarity of purpose, accountability and decision rights across teams and geographies.
•    Build a strong senior leadership team with the capability to manage complex portfolios, lead transformation and partner effectively with the business.
•    Create an open and transparent leadership culture characterized by candid dialogue, constructive challenge and clear accountability.
•    Invest in leadership development, succession and capability building, empowering leaders while holding them accountable for outcomes.
•    Lead teams successfully through significant organizational and technology change, maintaining engagement, stability and delivery performance.
•    Build effective partnerships across business, technology and corporate functions, breaking down organizational boundaries to achieve enterprise outcomes.

About You

You are a global technology executive with a track record of leading complex technology organizations and transformation at significant scale.
You combine strategic vision with strong operational and commercial judgment. You understand that technology transformation is not an objective in itself: successful transformation starts with understanding the business problem, determining where change creates value and executing with discipline.
Your experience has given you a strong understanding of operating within highly regulated financial services environments, where innovation and speed must be balanced with resilience, risk management and regulatory expectations.
You are equally comfortable discussing business strategy with senior executives, challenging technology investment decisions, navigating regulatory requirements and engaging with technology leaders on engineering, architecture and delivery.
As a leader, you create structure and transparency in complex environments. You set clear expectations and provide candid feedback while giving leaders the trust and space to succeed. You are passionate about developing people and building leadership capability that extends beyond your own organization.
You bring an international perspective and have demonstrated the ability to lead successfully across geographies, cultures and organizational boundaries.

Experience & Capabilities

•    Extensive senior executive experience in technology, digital or engineering leadership within large, complex global organizations.
•    Significant experience within reinsurance, insurance, banking or broader financial services, including operating within highly regulated environments.
•    Proven accountability for large-scale global technology organizations, complex application landscapes and significant technology investment portfolios.
•    Experience owning technology end-to-end for a major business, business unit or portfolio, with clear accountability for strategy, delivery, operations and transformation.
•    A strong record of leading complex technology and organizational transformation, with demonstrable improvements in business performance, efficiency, resilience or cost.
•    Experience modernizing engineering practices, technology platforms and delivery models within established global organizations.
•    Strong commercial and financial management capabilities, including technology investment prioritization, vendor management, sourcing and cost optimization.
•    Experience designing or transforming technology operating models, including organizational structure, location strategy and global delivery capabilities.
•    Strong understanding of technology risk, regulatory compliance, operational resilience and control environments.
•    Experience leading and developing substantial global teams through periods of organizational and technological change.
•    Executive presence and the ability to influence, challenge and build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

•    Direct leadership experience within Property & Casualty insurance or reinsurance.
•    Experience applying AI, Generative AI, data, analytics and automation at enterprise scale.
•    Experience establishing or expanding global technology hubs and engineering capabilities.
•    Experience contributing to enterprise-wide technology capabilities and platforms beyond a single business or functional domain.
•    Experience leading major regulatory or compliance-driven technology programs across multiple jurisdictions.
•    Strong understanding of cloud, modern architecture and contemporary engineering methodologies.

title: Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics
description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.  

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

RBI’s Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence

RBI is strengthening its global procurement organization by establishing a Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence (CoE).

The CoE will provide commodity intelligence, data, risk management, and commercial decision support to procurement teams across RBI’s brands and markets. It will act as the analytical backbone of the global procurement function, helping regional teams make faster, data-driven sourcing and negotiation decisions.

Our Opportunity:

The Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics will build and lead RBI’s newly established CoE, including its operating model, governance, analytical capabilities, tools, and team.

This is a newly created global role for a commercially minded commodity leader with deep market expertise, strong negotiation experience, advanced analytical capabilities, and an interest in using AI and data to improve procurement decisions.

The role will focus primarily on the following direct commodity categories:

Sugar, Wheat, Soy, Corn, Pork, Beef, Chicken, Paperboard, and Potatoes

The CoE will own market intelligence, forecasting, cost modelling, risk management, sourcing strategy, and upstream commercial negotiations for these categories, depending on the market.

The role will also provide advisory intelligence and risk support for selected indirect categories, including metals, steel, engineering, energy, maintenance, repair and operations, and industrial gases.

The CoE will lead or support negotiations for upstream raw materials, including raw meat cuts, agricultural commodities, and packaging feedstocks.

RBI follows a five-day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working onsite five days per week.

Your Roles & Responsibilities:

Build and lead the Global Commodities & Intelligence CoE, establishing its operating model, governance, team structure, priorities, and ways of working with regional and global procurement teams.
Define RBI’s global commodity intelligence strategy, including frameworks for market monitoring, price forecasting, risk assessment, scenario planning, and procurement timing recommendations.
Develop and deploy AI-enabled intelligence capabilities, including forecasting models, real-time market monitoring, should-cost tools, scenario analysis, and executive risk dashboards.
Own RBI’s global commodity risk management strategy, covering forward contracting, index-linked pricing, supplier diversification, pooling opportunities, hedging considerations, and spot, forward, and long-term supply arrangements.
Lead upstream commodity negotiations across the direct category portfolio, from market analysis and strategy development through to supplier engagement and commercial execution, as appropriate by market.
Lead RBI’s Global Contingency and Risk Management Programme, including supply-chain stress testing, inventory and business-continuity planning, geopolitical and weather-risk analysis, reporting, and executive escalation.
Establish global should-cost models, cost benchmarks, and pricing mechanisms that help procurement teams validate supplier proposals and strengthen sourcing and negotiation decisions.
Manage external commodity consultancies, market-data providers, and intelligence platforms, while building an integrated and scalable data infrastructure across markets and functions.
Act as RBI’s global commodity intelligence leader, delivering market outlooks, cost-impact analysis, sourcing recommendations, and executive briefings to senior procurement, finance, and brand leaders.
Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, and Brand teams to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, supply resilience, responsible sourcing, and stronger procurement governance.

Your skills & experience:

10+ years of progressive experience in global commodity procurement, trading, supply chain risk management, or commodity market intelligence within a large-scale FMCG, food service, QSR, or agri-food business.
Demonstrable expertise across at least three of the nine Direct categories; proven track record of executing upstream raw commodity negotiations at significant scale, including proteins (Beef, Chicken, Pork), grains, oilseeds, or packaging feedstocks.
Strong working knowledge of commodity markets, exchange mechanics (CME, CBOT, ICE), financial risk instruments (futures, options, swaps), and price risk management frameworks.
Proven experience deploying or commissioning AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics tools for commodity forecasting, market monitoring, or procurement decision support.
Experience building or leading a Centre of Excellence, intelligence function, or data capability within a complex global organization.
Track record of managing external consultancies, market data vendors, and analytics platform relationships at enterprise scale.
Experience operating within global matrixed organizations with multiple brands, procurement cooperatives, or franchise networks; able to influence without direct authority across regional structures.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate commodity market dynamics into clear business recommendations and financial impact models.
Excellent communicator and executive presence; comfortable presenting to C-suite and Board-level audiences.
Fluent in English; additional languages (French, German, Spanish, Portuguese) are an asset.

We are looking for:

A seasoned commodity professional who can build and lead a high-impact global intelligence function while also owning the commercial execution of RBI’s upstream raw commodity portfolio. You operate at the intersection of markets, data, and strategy. You are as comfortable at the negotiating table as you are presenting a risk scenario to the Board. You influence regional teams through the quality of your intelligence and the rigor of your commercial outcomes. You are energized by complexity, clarity, and building things that others depend on.

title: Global Consumer/Media Data & AI Strategy Lead m/f/d
description:
At Bayer we're visionaries, driven to solve the world's toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none' is nolonger a dream, but a real possibility. We're doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives ofthose around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining 'impossible'. There are so many reasons to join us. If you'rehungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there's only one choice.

Global Consumer/Media Data \& AI Strategy Lead m/f/d

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Global Consumer/Media Data \& AI Strategy Lead will own and evolve consumer and media data as a strategic enterprise asset across Marketing, Media, Consumer Insights, and the broader commercial organization. This role is central to our ambition of building marketing systems that are predictive, privacy\-compliant, and connected to real consumer behavior — enabling personalization, measurement, and sustained business impact at global scale.

This leader will define the vision and roadmap for how we strategically acquire, structure, govern, activate, and measure consumer and media data across all channels, platforms, and markets. They will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Media, Insights, Digital, IT, and regional teams — as well as external data partners, research vendors, and platform providers — to ensure our data ecosystem fuels meaningful consumer understanding, more precise audience engagement, and stronger marketing performance.

The future of consumer data strategy is being fundamentally reshaped by the convergence of AI and the role will shape that future; built through robust data foundations, governed with rigor, and activated through intelligent systems that are transparent, compliant, and interoperable across markets.

This role is part of Global Data \& AI Capability a vertical within Insights \& Analytics (I\&A) Home.

**Key Tasks/ What You'll Do**

* Define the global vision and roadmap for evolving, governing, activating, and measuring consumer and media data across channels and markets — with activation\-ready frameworks and clear pathways to value realization.
* Translating media and measurement and consumer insights needs from MMM, CPLT and other measurement approaches into clear, globally scalable data strategy and act as a neutral advocate behind recommendations

title: Director of Research
description:
100%

Shape the future of orthopaedics.

**Your challenge**

At the Schulthess Clinic, research is at the heart of how we continuously improve patient care and outcomes. As Director of Research, you will bring together clinicians, researchers, the Schulthess Foundation and external partners around a shared ambition: **to shape the future of orthopaedics**. Working at the interface between clinical departments and research groups, you will help translate scientific excellence into better patient care, innovation and measurable impact.  


* Shape and coordinate the research strategy of the Schulthess Clinic and translate our strategic priorities into a shared research agenda
* Bring together clinical departments and research groups and enable ambitious multidisciplinary research programmes
* Identify and prioritise scientific, clinical and technological opportunities with the potential to transform musculoskeletal care
* Develop shared capabilities in outcomes research, data science and artificial intelligence
* Build strategic partnerships with leading academic institutions, healthcare organisations, foundations and industry
* Promote competitive research funding and help attract third\-party funding
* Strengthen the international visibility and impact of our research
* Monitor research performance and scientific impact and provide strategic reporting to our governing bodies


**What impresses us**

* A **collaborative leader, connector and enabler** who brings people together and enables others to succeed
* Scientific credibility and a strong understanding of the interface between clinical care and research
* Strategic vision and the ability to translate it into a focused research agenda
* Experience in leading multidisciplinary research programs and securing competitive research funding
* A strong international network and the ability to build strategic collaborations
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* The ability to bridge clinical, scientific and institutional perspectives and create institutional impact
* Good command of German, both written and spoken, is desirable.

**What you get**

* The opportunity to join one of the world's leading orthopaedic institutions, combining clinical excellence with world\-leading musculoskeletal research
* An exceptional environment where clinicians and researchers work on questions with direct relevance to patient care
* Access to a strong research ecosystem with unique capabilities in outcomes research, data science and multidisciplinary collaboration
* The opportunity to work with leading clinicians, researchers and external partners across an international network
* A role at the heart of an institution committed to translating research into measurable impact for patients and society


**What you get**

* Possibility of working from home
* Attractive social security contributions and numerous benefits
* Team spirit
* Training opportunities


"Your next challenge: excellence meets responsibility"

**Questions about the job?**

**Vera Rüttimann**  
HR Business Partner

SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m,f,d) \- Performance \& Goals \- 100%  

Project: For an ongoing SAP SuccessFactors Programme, we are looking for a Senior SAP SuccessFactors Consultant to support daily operations and the rollout of key HR modules.  

The project includes Performance Management and Goals, Succession Management and a planned implementation from February 2027\.  

Tasks:  

\* Support the daily operation of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central in line with agreed SLAs  
\* Support the rollout of Performance Management and Goals and Succession Management  
\* Support the implementation of the Compensation module planned from February 2027  
\* Advise HR departments and other stakeholders on SAP SuccessFactors solutions  
\* Analyse business and technical requirements and support their implementation  
\* Monitor and troubleshoot interfaces between SAP SuccessFactors and other systems  
\* Provide second\- and third\-level application support  
\* Analyse and resolve incidents and system issues  
\* Monitor HR data flows and replication interfaces to other SAP systems  
\* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, the software provider and external implementation partners  

Required Skills \& Experience:  

\* At least five years of project experience implementing SAP SuccessFactors  
\* Practical application support experience with SAP SuccessFactors  
\* Strong experience with Employee Central  
\* Experience with Performance Management and Goals  
\* Experience with the Compensation module  
\* Technical knowledge of SuccessFactors configuration, interfaces and end\-to\-end integration  
\* Experience with requirements management and test management  
\* Ability to translate business and technical requirements into effective SuccessFactors solutions  
\* Degree in business administration, business informatics or an equivalent professional qualification  
\* Strong communication skills and a service\-oriented approach  

Nice to have:  

\* Experience with SuccessFactors Succession Management  
\* Experience supporting further SuccessFactors module implementations  
\* Experience working on cloud implementation projects  

Languages:  

\* Fluent English (written and spoken)  
\* German advantageous  
\* Spanish advantageous
